verdict.rationale: Each sync connects one model to one destination and defines how fields map into it, so you can choose per destination which attributes flow. That implies field-level filtering, but the evidence never frames it as a privacy or PII control. Nothing in the evidence documents hashing or masking of sensitive attributes. Missing for 10: documented hashing of PII per destination, masking/redaction controls, explicit sensitive-field filtering or PII policies, independent corroboration.
